strengths.coach: Kept the ball like it owed you money.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You were everywhere. Teammates looked for you because they trust you.

strengths.detail: Key passes: 3 (top quarter of midfielders: 2+); 1 assist, 3 key passes
strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

strengths.title: Match-winning impact
strengths.coach: Man of the Match. The game noticed, and so did I.

weaknesses.detail: Tackles attempted: 1 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 2 or less)
weaknesses.title: Defensive work rate
tips: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs.
weaknesses.coach: Need more bite without the ball. Defending is everybody's job.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: Well, BellyTb1, a 9.0 is the kind of night you tell your grandkids about. Top 10% of midfielders, and you earned every bit.
coach.closer: Proud of you. Now go drink some water.

push.title: D 3-3 vs Bluecocks BC | You: 9.0 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
Ring the bell, BellyTb1. A 9.0 puts you in rare air for a midfielder. Top ten percent, baby.

DID WELL
+ 89% passing on 27 attempts, up from your usual 74%. Every ball arrived like it had a GPS.
+ 27 passes (up from your usual 20). You were in the middle of everything, like gravy on mashed potatoes.
+ 3 key passes, the most you've made for us. That's what I call neighborly football.
+ A brace against Bluecocks BC. That's a finish they'll replay at the club banquet.
+ Man of the Match, your 6th for us. Top performer, top teammate.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Little homework: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.

Training note: As a CDM/CM, screen the back line: stay between the ball and our goal and pick off passes.

Couldn't have asked for more. - Coach Lasso

players.name: tuxedo_slide

strengths.title: Tackle timing
strengths.note: Wins the ball cleanly and rarely gets beaten in the duel.
strengths.coach: When you went in, you came out with the ball. That's timing.

strengths.detail: Key passes: 3 (top quarter of midfielders: 2+); 1 assist, 3 key passes
strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Made chances for your teammates. Unselfish football is the best kind.

weaknesses.detail: 12/22 passes (54%) - below the ~72% point where extra passes start costing rating
weaknesses.title: Forcing passes
tips: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
weaknesses.coach: We tried to force a few too many. Not every pass has to be a love letter.

players.headline: Strong midfielder performance (7.9, top 25% for the position) - best at tackle timing, chance creation; work on forcing passes.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: Now that's what I'm talking about, tuxedo_slide. A 7.9 puts you in the top quarter of midfielders.
coach.closer: Keep that up and I'll have to start buying bigger biscuit tins.

push.title: D 3-3 vs Bluecocks BC | You: 7.9 (top 25% MID)
push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 7.9. You played with your head up and your heart out. Love to see it.

DID WELL
+ Won 2 of 4 tackles (up from your usual 0%). You knew exactly when to go, and you went.
+ 3 key passes, the most you've made for us. That's a pass with a bow on it.
+ Your vision plus BellyTb1's finishing equals a very happy coach.
+ League-wide, a 7.9 is top 25% territory for a midfielder.
+ Drew 3-3. The win was right there; let's go grab it next time.

WORK ON
- 54% passing (12 of 22). Between you and me: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
- 2 shots off target: -0.1. Easy upgrade available.
- Passes attempted: 22. 25+ is the gold standard for a midfielder.
- Tackles attempted: 4. You're in the neighborhood. The fancy houses start at 6+.

This week's homework: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.

Keep that fire burning. - Coach Lasso

push.title: D 3-3 vs Bluecocks BC | You: 7.7 (above average FOR)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.7. That's what I call putting a quarter in the jukebox and getting a good song.

DID WELL
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. You made the keeper make decisions, and that's the job.
+ 2 key passes. You played the pass before the defense knew it was a possibility.
+ A goal against Bluecocks BC, your 5th straight match scoring. Never gets old, and I hope it never does.
+ Your passes to BellyTb1 had perfect weight and perfect timing.
+ Even at 3-3 with Bluecocks BC. Let's find the winner next time.

WORK ON
- Pass accuracy: 76%. Let's make 88%+ the habit.
- Shots: 2. Solid, but the best forwards hit 3+.
- Goals per shot on target: 50%. Top forwards reach 60%+. You've got the legs for it.

Gold star, big hug, see you next match. - Coach Lasso
